Trump: U.S. Navy Aegis guided missile destroyer USS SPRUANCE fired upon the Iranian-flagged cargo ship TOUSKA after fair warning to stop. TOUSKA was violating the US blockade of Iranian vessels and was already under sanctions. U.S. Marines have custody of the vessel.
